name: lease_profile
description: Reserve a free profile, start its browser, bind a tab, and return the handle.

name: lease_fleet
description: The same for several profiles at once, one handle each.

name: lease_renew
description: Push the reservation's deadline out without losing the handle.

name: start_run
description: Say in one sentence what this stretch of work is for, so the operator sees it.

name: release_profile
description: End the reservation and stop the browser. Records how the work went.

name: open_page
description: Navigate to a public http or https address, and get the full page map back.

name: snapshot
description: What is on the page now. A diff, unless you ask for a full map.

name: click
description: Click an element, optionally a point inside it, for a picture rather than a control.

name: press_and_hold
description: The whole press-and-hold gesture, in one call.

name: type_text
description: Click a field and type into it at this profile's own cadence.

name: fill_form
description: Several fields in one call.

name: press_key
description: A key, including modifier chords.

name: scroll
description: A real wheel gesture with momentum, not a jump.

name: wait_for
description: Wait for text or an element to appear, to go, or for the page to go quiet.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the page or one element, for when the text map cannot describe it.

name: record
description: Start or stop recording what the browser is doing.

name: video
description: Turn a recording into a film, and check on one that is rendering.

name: read_value
description: Read one thing from an element: text, an allowed attribute, a count, a table.

name: read_text
description: Read the page's prose verbatim, for an article or a thread of comments.

name: interruption_respond
description: Answer what the browser itself is asking: a permission prompt, a device chooser.

name: secret_list
description: Which values this profile holds that the agent may use but not read.

name: interact
description: Hover, drag, upload a file, or choose from a native dropdown.

name: navigate
description: History and tabs, including the popup a click just opened.

name: measure_frames
description: How a moving element behaves over time, for a slider or an animation.

name: measure_gap
description: The distance between two elements, for a puzzle piece and its slot.

name: transcribe_audio
description: Turn an audio challenge into text, through the operator's own command.

name: measure_rotation
description: How far an image is turned, for a rotation challenge.

name: interruption_list
description: What the browser is currently asking, if anything.

name: passkey_list
description: Which sites this profile can sign in to without a password.

name: passkey_retire
description: Stop this profile from offering one passkey, for good.

name: cookie_list
description: The shape of the cookie jar. Never a value.

name: cookie_delete
description: Remove one cookie, or every cookie of one site.

name: page_report
description: Console messages and a request summary. Never headers, cookies or bodies.

name: clipboard
description: Read or write the clipboard of the bound tab.

name: save_pdf
description: Save the current page as a PDF artifact.

name: download_file
description: Follow a download and keep the result as an artifact.

name: artifact_list
description: What this profile has produced: screenshots, downloads, PDFs, recordings.

name: run_list
description: This profile's earlier runs, so an agent can see what was already tried.

name: profile.list
description: The profiles on this daemon, with their state.

name: profile.create
description: Create a profile with a fresh identity.

name: profile.start
description: Start a profile's browser. Does not give you one you can drive.

name: profile.stop
description: Stop a profile's browser.

name: profile.update
description: Change a profile's settings: name, proxy, group, geo mode.

name: input.humanize
description: Dispatch one humanized gesture at a coordinate, outside the page map.

name: session.export
description: A profile's session as a password-encrypted bundle.

name: session.import
description: Unseal such a bundle into a profile.

name: credential.list
description: Which platforms a profile can log into. Account names, never secrets.

name: group.list
description: The groups profiles are labelled with.

name: profile.batch
description: Start, stop, delete, or reassign a proxy or extensions across many profiles.

name: preset.instantiate
description: Make a fleet from a template: N profiles, each with its own identity.

name: task.list
description: What is outstanding on a profile.

name: task.add
description: Put work on a profile's list, for now or for later.

name: task.start
description: Mark a task as being worked on.

name: task.done
description: Close a task, with what came of it.

name: task.cancel
description: Drop a task that no longer applies.

name: proxy.list
description: The proxy pool. Never credentials.

name: extension.list
description: The extension library, and what each profile loads.

name: preset.list
description: The stored templates.

name: group.create
description: Create a group.

name: group.delete
description: Delete a group. Its profiles stay.

name: credential_fill
description: Sign in with this profile's stored login. The agent never receives it.

name: credential_new
description: Sign up: the daemon draws the password, stores it, and types it.

name: credential_store
description: Put a login the profile already has into the vault.

name: read_inbox
description: The profile's confirmation codes, by mail or by text.

name: inbox_open_link
description: Open a link out of a message, by its number. The address is never shown.
